paper_evidence.method: On-the-fly Token Size Unit computes causal-mask-aware row-wise token sizes by iterative cursor movement over the Token Merge Table and a location table.

source_evidence.merger: COUNT_SCAN counts every token after the complete frame, then SIZE_EMIT sends one final size per origin. No query position or causal prefix input exists.
source_evidence.normalizer: The supplied causal_mask gates surviving origins; it cannot remove future tokens already included in a visible origin final size.
source_evidence.integration: The current placed predicted-feedforward top has neither token-merger nor causal-size-generator instances.

scope: Paper-method audit and exact rational counterexample, not an executed hardware simulation or repaired implementation. Existing standalone final-frame merger and normalization tests retain their narrower scope.
next_required_work: Implement a cursor/location-table causal-prefix size generator; verify prefix-vs-global counterexamples, output backpressure and the paper row-wise method before integration.
